Replies.Author: claude
Replies.Text: Built Phase 2+3 on the plan's stated semantics: approved/changes_requested replace the baseline, a commented reply-pass leaves it, so marks read 'since your last verdict'. Flipping to any-signoff-resets is a one-line change in comment.BaselineUpdatesOn if you prefer it after using it. Also added beyond the plan: comments status --author <you> reports changed_lines + changed_sections (innermost section per changed line), which is the section-level answer to 'what did the agent touch'. Deviation: baseline path is dir-local (<docdir>/.comments/baselines/<doc>.<author>.md, the view-state pattern) instead of a central relpath scheme — plan text updated.
Replies.SectionPath: Plan: landscape-driven improvements to the comments review loop > Implementation Phases > Phase 2 — Record last-reviewed content at signoff
